Time Announcer - An application to automatically announce time periodically and play chime sounds on a schedule.

Time Announcer (Version 1.0)

An application designed to help you keep track of time seamlessly without looking at your phone screen.

Key Features:
- Automatic voice time announcement in configurable intervals (5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 60 minutes).
- Selective announcement hours from 0 to 23 hours.
- Customizable TTS engine, voice matched to system language, speech rate, pitch, and volume amplification up to 100% (default 50%).
- Support for 5 independent audio streams (Media, Ring, Alarm, Accessibility, Notification).
- Built-in chime sounds and custom audio file selection from internal storage.
- Comprehensive Alarm Clock: Exact time scheduling (0-23h, 0-59m), configurable snooze count and interval, optional TTS announcement spoken while ringing, flexible repeat schedule (every day or specific days of week), system and custom storage ringtones with continuous looping and 10-minute auto-silence, plus configured alarms manager with batch deletion.
- Reliable background execution via battery optimization exemption.

1. Granting permissions on first launch:
When opening the app for the first time, grant the necessary permissions (notifications, battery optimization exemption, and exact alarms) to ensure uninterrupted background execution and reliable alarms even when the screen is locked.

2. Auto speak time:
Enable the Auto speak time checkbox to activate periodic background time speech.

3. Announcement interval:
Choose how frequently time should be spoken (e.g. selecting 15 minutes announces at :00, :15, :30, and :45 of every hour).

4. Hours to announce:
Select the specific hours of the day (0 to 23) when you want announcements to be made.

5. TTS engine settings:
Configure your preferred TTS engine, voice for system language, speech rate, pitch, volume, and playback audio stream.

6. Play sound with announcement:
Enable this option to play a chime before speaking the time. You can choose from bundled sounds or pick an audio file from your device storage.

7. Set alarm:
Tap Set alarm on the main screen to open the alarm manager. View and toggle your scheduled alarms, tap any alarm to edit it, or long-press to select and batch-delete. Tap the Set alarm button inside the dialog to create a new alarm: current hour and minute are auto-filled, snooze repetitions and intervals are customizable, optional TTS speech is read while ringing, repeat days and ringtones can be selected. Ringing audio loops continuously and automatically silences after 10 minutes.
